title: Group Fitness Class Passes: booking advance window, daily booking limit and specialty surcharge/notice by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states how far ahead a class may be booked, the maximum number of classes bookable in a single calendar day, the extra advance notice required for a specialty class, and the surcharge charged for a specialty class booking.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes how many hours ahead of a class's start a booking may be made, and the maximum number of classes that may be booked for a single calendar day. Each tier also fixes an extra credit-equivalent surcharge for booking a specialty class (zero where a specialty surcharge is already included in the tier's ordinary credit) and, independently, extra advance-booking notice a specialty class booking requires beyond the tier's ordinary booking-advance window.

| Tier | Booking advance window (hours) | Max bookings per day | Specialty surcharge (USD) | Extra notice for specialty (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 72 | 2 | 10.00 | 0 |
| 10-Class Pack | 96 | 2 | 10.00 | 0 |
| 20-Class Pack | 120 | 3 | 5.00 | 12 |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | 48 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 168 | 2 | 0 | 24 |
| Founding Class Pass | 168 | 3 | 5.00 | 12 |

## Points of judgement
- The Specialty Studio Pack charges no extra specialty surcharge because its credits already cover specialty classes exclusively, but it requires the most extra advance notice (24 hours) of any tier for those bookings.
- The Unlimited Monthly Classes tier charges no specialty surcharge and requires no extra specialty notice, consistent with its credits covering all class types without a per-class surcharge structure.
